editorial_ethos.philosophy: Inclusive Publishing / Sound Science / Validated Research
editorial_ethos.remit: To ensure there is a home for all validated research. All valid research has a contribution to make.
editorial_ethos.core_directive_for_referees: Referees are explicitly asked NOT to assess the significance, perceived impact, or novelty of the research. Focus exclusively on ensuring results are sound and accurately reported.

ai_policy.confidentiality_rule: Handling editors and reviewers must treat the review process as strictly confidential. Manuscripts and extracted information must NOT be uploaded into generative AI tools.

supported_article_types.Research: Standard original research focused on methodological validity and reproducibility.
supported_article_types.Data Notes: Concise descriptions of sound datasets to increase reuse. Reviewers must NOT ask for extensive follow-up experiments or confirmation of hypotheses; in-depth analyses should be removed.
supported_article_types.Registered Reports: Two-stage review: Stage 1 (research question, hypotheses, power analysis, outcome-neutral tests) -> In Principle Acceptance (IPA); Stage 2 (adherence to pre-registered plan, post hoc analysis justification).
supported_article_types.Review Articles: Critical accounts and surveys providing new insights, not just a summary of what has been published; clear inclusion/exclusion methodology.

core_review_criteria.name: Scope & Article Type Check
core_review_criteria.description: Ensure manuscript fits journal remit and conforms to the rules of its specific article type.

core_review_criteria.name: Methodological Validity
core_review_criteria.description: Determine if manuscript has fundamental flaws that prohibit publication. Reject only if fundamentally flawed beyond what can be reasonably addressed in revision.

core_review_criteria.name: Data Transparency & Supplementary Review
core_review_criteria.description: Review all extended data and supplementary info. Verify methods and processing steps are sufficiently detailed for exact reproduction.

core_review_criteria.name: Statistical Rigor & Error Bars
core_review_criteria.description: All error bars must be defined in figure legends. Evaluate appropriateness of statistical tests, p-values, and treatment of uncertainties.

core_review_criteria.name: Robust Conclusions & Overclaiming Avoidance
core_review_criteria.description: If conclusions are overstated compared to data, require authors to define explicit limitations so the text reports exactly what data show.

core_review_criteria.name: Appropriate Literature & No Reviewer-Coerced Citations
core_review_criteria.description: Check literature coverage. Suggest sections or topics needing improvement, NOT specific self-citations. Coerced citations are strictly penalized.

core_review_criteria.name: SAGER Guidelines & Research Misconduct
core_review_criteria.description: Check Sex and Gender in Research (SAGER) guidelines. Alert editor confidentially of any plagiarism or image manipulation concerns.

decision_framework.reject_criteria: Fundamental flaws in methodology, invalid data interpretation, unfixable fatal errors beyond reasonable revision scope.
decision_framework.revision_criteria: Sound research with essential revisions: overclaiming tone adjustment, explicit limitation statements, statistical clarification, supplementary data transparency.
